method.engines: Alternating stock/native order within each trial; separate JVM for each revision/release/case
method.boundary: Complete jobs: runtime RowData source, both perimeter transposes, production JNI/IPC/state, row blackhole sink; EXPLAIN both engines before timing; initial cluster setup outside timing; per-job planning/startup/completion remain timed
method.types: nullable BIGINT values; INT keys; callback Long -> Long, nondeterministic; NULL every seventh value
method.mini_batch: ONE_PHASE, 1024 rows, 1h processing-time interval; memory state
method.native_build: release --no-default-features --features mimalloc; same settings and Cargo.lock for both native revisions; RocksDB disabled locally, normal full-feature builds in CI
method.reproduction: See NativeBoundaryBenchmark and optimization page; SF_BENCHMARK=true, -Pbench, surefire:test@default-test, boundary.* properties

profile.limitations: Inclusive CPU/allocation categories overlap; not pure JNI latency, allocated bytes or copied bytes; includes both engines, startup/JIT/planning and warmups; profiled timings excluded from performance comparisons

initial_prototype_confirmation.api_revision: Earlier sentinel prototype, before the explicit JNI entry point
initial_prototype_confirmation.reason: The original Flink1.18 join1024 native median increased39%; a five-minute bounded reverse-order benchmark check retained both outcomes. No second profiling/optimization pass.
initial_prototype_confirmation.conclusion: The original regression did not repeat; medians and stock controls shift with startup/arrival scheduling. Join speedup/regression attribution remains unresolved, not dismissed. Retain both sets; no blanket pipeline speedup claim.

prototype.scope: Immutable dictionary-free Calc output schemas; explicit JNI cached-schema entry point delegates existing array-only handoff; no generic handle protocol
prototype.compatibility_revision: Initial implementation and timings fit the30-minute prototype budget. Final API review added a distinct JNI entry point to avoid a stale library interpreting the new zero-pointer contract. Builds, the stale-library probe, the complete timing matrix and focused tests were repeated for this compatibility correction; no extra profiling or optimization pass.
prototype.decision: Retain measured metadata reduction; broader wrapper/ownership redesign deferred after this pass

limitations: Host is WSL2 Intel i7-12650H and is not reserved. CPU affinity and heap are identical; retain stock-control drift and ranges. No task compilation or tests overlap these final full-job runs.
These complete-job observations include startup/planning and are not isolated kernel or sustained throughput claims.

An earlier 2M-row combined matrix encountered memory pressure when another benchmark started. It was stopped and excluded in full; its partial observations remain in the evidence archive. Final cases use fresh JVMs and smaller join fixtures.

A raw dictionary fixture failed identically on baseline and candidate; it was not a valid new regression oracle. Dictionary output schemas retain the full import path; no new dictionary support is claimed.
Mixed-profile output and a validation fork against the wrong snapshot were discarded during setup. Final runs pin immutable native library snapshots and separate Flink checkouts.

validation.full_ci: Required on final PR head before merge
